notes: SBLGNT.MAT.4.3.v001 is underdetermined on r00-base; the English realizes every token of that reading, so nothing is added or surplus (rule 12).
ὁ πειράζων splits determiner-plus-nominal: *tempter* glosses πειράζω itself and is no supplied nominal, so rule 102 does not carry it to the article (rules 22, 32, 90).
οἱ before λίθοι is emptied by the attributive demonstrative οὗτοι (rule 38); τοῦ before θεοῦ is emptied for want of a determiner, the case preposition staying with the noun (rules 21, 23).
